title: Uniform law assigns each disjoint coordinate probability one third
statement: Let a *disjoint coordinate* be one of the three symbols $\{\text{neither},\ \text{leftOnly},\ \text{rightOnly}\}$, and let $\mu$ be the uniform law on this three-element set. Then for every disjoint coordinate $c$, the measure of the singleton $\{c\}$ satisfies $\mu(\{c\}) = \tfrac{1}{3}$.
hypotheses_covered: c ranges over the three-element type of disjoint coordinates
replaced: Each disjoint coordinate has mass $1 / 3$ under the one-coordinate uniform law.
